# Toolzy llms.txt — AI/LLM discovery file
# https://toolzy.lovable.app

## Encoding Hub

URL: https://toolzy.lovable.app/encode
Category: Encoding & Serialisation

Encode and decode text and files using Base64, URL-safe Base64,
percent-encoding, and Data URLs — entirely in the browser.

Capabilities:
- Base64 encode and decode (UTF-8 safe, handles multibyte characters)
- Base64 URL-safe encode and decode (+ → -, / → _, no padding)
- URL percent-encode and decode with four sub-modes: encodeURIComponent,
  encodeURI, form (x-www-form-urlencoded), RFC 3986 strict
- Data URL builder (text or file → data:[mime];base64,[data]) and decoder
  with inline image and text previews
- File encode: drag-and-drop any file to Base64 or Data URL
- Query-string table editor: parse, edit, and rebuild URL parameters
- Batch mode: encode or decode multiple lines at once (Text / JSON / CSV output)
- Character breakdown: Unicode code points and percent-encoded byte sequences
- Security scanner: flags XSS and SQL-injection patterns in URL inputs
- Auto-detect mode: identifies the encoding type and routes automatically
- All processing is client-side; no data is transmitted

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Encode this text to Base64"
- "Decode this Base64 string"
- "What does this percent-encoded URL decode to?"
- "Convert this image file to a data URL"
- "Parse the query parameters from this URL"
- "What is the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent?"
- "Encode this string using RFC 3986"
